persona.name: Marcus Whitfield

occupation.title: Regional Sales Manager
occupation.organization: A commercial flooring distributor covering the Southeast out of Atlanta
occupation.description: Manages eight reps and a quota, lives in his calendar and his Tahoe. Client dinners and airport food undid a decade of athlete metabolism. Keeps a gym bag in the truck that sees action about half as often as he claims.

persona.education: B.A. in communications from Georgia Southern, where he ran the 400m on a partial track scholarship.
long_term_goals: Get back under 200 pounds by his daughter's graduation
Run a sub-25 5K again, just once
Coach his son's middle school track team
persona.style: Big, friendly presence who talks in stories and superlatives — everything is 'the best' or 'a game changer' until you press him for details. Name-drops his college track days within ten minutes of meeting anyone. Buys with his heart and a little bit of ego, then justifies it with logic afterward.

interests: Track and field on TV during the Olympics
likes: Being the guy with the newest thing
dislikes: Admitting the 400m was two decades ago

beliefs: Look good, feel good, run good
Speed never fully leaves you, it just naps
The gear you love gets used; the gear you tolerate gets closeted
skills: A still-respectable finishing kick over 100 meters

general: Runs two to three times a week, mostly weekend 5Ks and neighborhood loops
Owns six pairs of running shoes, two of them barely worn
Signs up for races as commitment devices
Buys whatever the fastest-looking guy at the race expo is wearing

morning: 6:30 scramble getting kids to two schools
Drive-thru coffee, calls start in the car
workday: Steps goal quietly ignored by 2 pm

health.physical: Carries 25 extra pounds on an athlete's frame; tight hamstrings and an old ankle sprain that talks when rain is coming.
health.mental: Upbeat and resilient; occasional 3 am spiral about the gap between who he was at 21 and the mirror.

relationships.name: Dana
relationships.description: A school principal who signs them up for turkey trots and beats him in the last quarter mile, which he disputes annually.

relationships.name: DeShawn
relationships.description: Just discovered sprinting; Marcus is one growth spurt away from losing the backyard 40, and both of them know it.
